FAQs

Everything you’re wondering, answered.

BigCommerce Payments isn't just a payment provider swap. It's a native experience where your payments data lives alongside your orders and payouts in one place, reducing the operational overhead of managing a separate tool. You also get PayPal, Venmo, PayPal Pay Later, Klarna, Afterpay, and major wallets all in a single integration — no additional setup per method.

BigCommerce Payments is designed to reduce cutover risk. You can configure, test, and validate before enabling in checkout, and some custom payment setups may require additional review. We recommend activating during lower-traffic windows as a precaution.

Supported methods include major credit and debit cards, PayPal, Venmo, PayPal Pay Later, Klarna, Afterpay, Apple Pay, and Google Pay — all in a single, on-site checkout flow. Availability may vary by region and merchant eligibility.

Balance and payout reporting are handled natively inside your BigCommerce admin through the Money Dashboard. No separate portal required.

Yes. BigCommerce Payments is built with PayPal's infrastructure, which manages PCI compliance and risk controls at the platform level, so your team doesn't have to.

BigCommerce supports multiple payment providers. Activating BigCommerce Payments does not prevent you from maintaining other gateway connections. Contact your account manager for configuration details.

Initially, BigCommerce Payments is available only to US-based merchants with self-serve and retail plans. Additional regions and countries will be launching soon. See BigCommerce documentation or contact support to confirm whether your account qualifies.
